Разрешения, свободная орбита, наличие тр: The route does not guarantee permits, an available orbital slot, tritium stocks or convenient mining sites.
Для первого шага и дальнейшего расширени: Consider a compact orbital outpost for your first step and later expansion. If you need access for large cargo ships, consider a Coriolis with large landing pads. Compare the actual commodity requirements: the supply workload determines how quickly you can build. The primary port cannot be replaced after completion.
Стройте ступенями: T1 → T2 → T3: Build in stages: T1 → T2 → T3
Объекты T1 дают очки T2. За них строятся: T1 facilities generate T2 points. Spend them on T2 hubs and large settlements, which generate T3 points for a T3 port. A large T2 settlement provides two T3 points; a standard T2 hub provides one. Starting additional T2/T3 ports increases the cost of later ports; the primary port is excluded from that count. If you want T3 ports, compare a build order that places them before additional T2 ports.
Сохраните роль первичного порта: Keep the primary port in your plan
Первичный порт уже построен: его нельзя: The primary port is complete and cannot be demolished or replaced. Plan further development through additional facilities and check their links to ports.
Рассмотрите перерабатывающий узел и порт: Consider a refinery hub and a port around the same celestial body. Check the body's properties and connections on the system map: one specialised facility does not guarantee a purely refinery economy.
Рассмотрите промышленный узел и промышле: Consider an industrial hub and an industrial outpost. Choose the industrial specialisation for settlements in the game. Check which facilities will link to the selected port.
Рассмотрите добывающий узел и добывающую: Consider an extraction hub and a mining installation. An asteroid base may be an option at a suitable ring location. Confirm the placement and availability of the specific facility on the system map.
Рассмотрите космическую ферму и поселени: Consider a space farm and a settlement with an agricultural specialisation. Choose suitable bodies and port connections; verify demand and production against the resulting economy in the game.
Рассмотрите высокотехнологичный или науч: Consider a high-tech or scientific hub, a scientific outpost and a research installation. Check local port connections and whether the resulting economies work together.
Рассмотрите военный узел, военный аванпо: Consider a military hub, a military outpost and a military installation; choose a military specialisation for the settlement. Confirm the available services and resulting economies in the game.
Рассмотрите туристическую установку и ту: Consider a tourist installation and a tourism settlement. Account for the body's properties and local port connections. Exact income from this development path is not calculated in advance.
Рассмотрите опорный узел и космический б: Consider an outpost hub and a space bar, then check the services at connected ports. A particular facility alone does not confirm that the port will have the desired economy.
Сначала определите, какие услуги и товар: First identify the services and commodities your routes need. Choose specialised hubs and settlements, then compare their port connections. As you combine more development paths, checking the actual economic shares in the game becomes more important.
Задайте направление экономики в параметр: Set the target economy in the project settings so the plan can suggest suitable facility families. Confirm economic proportions, available slots and market results in the game.
По текущей очереди перед этим этапом не: The current queue is short of %.0f T2 points before this stage. Place suitable T1 facilities earlier and complete them. Then update the current balance from the architect's screen. Do not allocate the same points to parallel construction projects.

The current queue is short of %.0f T3 points before this stage. Place the required T2 hubs or large settlements earlier and complete them, securing their T2 points first. Then update the balance from the architect's screen.
Ещё %d этапов имеют расчётный дефицит оч: %d more stages have an estimated point deficit. Start with the first warning in the queue and recalculate the plan after changing the order.
Введите доступные очки T2 и T3 по экрану: Enter the available T2 and T3 points shown on the architect's screen. This is the current balance, already accounting for existing facilities and construction in progress. Until the balance is known, the next stage cannot be confirmed as ready to start.
Проверьте заявку на %s у контакта колони: Check the claim for %s at the colonisation contact.
